sources.title: Clover 35B A3B Preview | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Clover 35B A3B Preview is a diffusion language model with 35B total parameters and about 3B active per token, built as a mixture of experts on a hybrid Gated DeltaNet and full attention backbone. It generates text in blocks through iterative denoising instead of one token at a time, supports a 128K token context window and a thinking mode, and is tuned for agentic tasks, coding, and reasoning.
